output_json.diff_review: patch_only.diff touches two files: (1) FileResourceManager.java — inserts a containment check before the exists()/case check: canonicalizes both the resolved file and the base, appends File.separator to base, and returns null if (canonicalFile + separator) does not start with the base canonical path. This correctly allows the base root itself and legitimate in-base subfiles while rejecting ../ escapes, and the trailing-separator handling avoids the /foo vs /foobar prefix-collision false-negative. (2) A new FileResourceManagerTraversalTestCase with a negative case (traversal returns null) and a positive case (in-base file served). pov.diff only adds files under .security-pipeline/ and does not modify product code or the POV harness. The change is appropriate, minimal, and does not disable functionality or add unrelated behavior.

output_json.summary: The patch fixes CWE-022 path traversal in FileResourceManager.getResource by adding a canonical-path containment check at the exact vulnerable sink (new File(base, path), line 89). The resolved file's canonical path is compared against the canonicalized base directory (with a trailing separator to prevent sibling-prefix bypass like /foo vs /foobar), returning null when the path escapes base. The fix is minimal and targeted; the POV no longer reproduces and regressions pass.
